subject: Plain-language privacy snippets for Hosted API console — ACME review
messages:
From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick pass on your 'what we share' copy for ACME marketplace listing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for sending over the snippet set. Legal asked for a quick plain-language pass before we publish the marketplace tile. High-level asks below — I attached inline comments in the doc as well.

Key points we care about:
- Keep the subprocessor list description to one short sentence, then link to the detailed list.
- Clarify that ACME-originated data is retained for X days by default, and where customers can change retention via the console (if applicable).
- Stronger language around encryption in transit at minimum; customers want to see KMS/HSM as an option called out.

Can your team suggest two one-line alternatives for the "Who can access your data" line and one shorter line for cross-border transfers? ACME legal prefers brevity for the public tile.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re aiming to push the marketplace entry live the week of Aug 16.

Best,
Dana
Legal — ACME Corp

Attachments: change-log-ACME-comments.pdf

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pass on your 'what we share' copy for ACME marketplace listing

Dana — thanks for the notes and the annotated PDF, that was helpful. I pulled out the most actionable items and assigned them below.

Action items we can take before Aug 16:
- Provide two optional one-line variants for "Who can access your data" (Laura) — due EOD Aug 10.
- Shorten the cross-border transfers line and include a link to the transfer safeguards section (Kimberly) — due Aug 11.
- Add an explicit phrase about optional KMS/HSM and where to enable it in the console (Marcus) — will add a mockup screenshot.

I attached v2 of the snippet doc with inline edits; Laura and Kimberly, please review the suggested alternatives and flag anything that would trip legal.

If ACME legal is comfortable with the one-liners, we can swap them into the marketplace tile copy and the in-console privacy panel simultaneously.

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: dpa-plainlanguage-snippets-v2.docx, console-mockup-privacy-panel.png

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pass on your 'what we share' copy for ACME marketplace listing

Thanks — reviewed the two variants. I think Variant B is cleaner for the marketplace tile; Variant A is better for the console (slightly more explicit).

Suggested marketplace one-liner (Variant B):
"Only personnel and systems needed to operate the service can access your data — see our subprocessor list for details."

Suggested console one-liner (Variant A, slightly expanded):
"Access is limited to service infrastructure and authorized personnel; see subprocessor list and audit logs in your console."

On cross-border transfers: replace the previous paragraph with this shorter sentence for public-facing areas:
"We may transfer data internationally and rely on standard contractual safeguards — you can review details in our Data Processing Addendum."

Kimberly, Marcus — are the KMS/HSM phrasing and the console screenshot accurate? If so, I'll mark this ready for legal review and prod-ready copy.

Laura
Director, Product Content — Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pass on your 'what we share' copy for ACME marketplace listing

Laura — thanks, those read well. A few micro-edits and one legal-flag note (I added comments in the Drive doc):
- Substitute "personnel and systems" with "authorized personnel and systems" in the marketplace one-liner to avoid ambiguity.
- For the console text we need to add a hover tooltip explaining "audit logs" -> "shows access requests and actions taken by company staff and subprocessors".
- KMS/HSM phrasing I propose: "Encryption in transit and at rest; optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Dedicated and Private deployments."

If ACME legal is ok with the tooltip language, we can hand off to Legal for a final sign-off. Marcus — can you attach the mockup with the tooltip overlay?

Kimberly
Product Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachments: (see Drive link)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pass on your 'what we share' copy for ACME marketplace listing

Thanks all — attaching the screenshot with the tooltip and a short note on how retention controls surface in the console. Dana: I've kept the public tile wording intentionally concise and show the longer console copy in the mockup.

Next steps:
- Priyom: confirm final one-liners and make the swap in the marketplace tile copy (aim: Aug 13).
- Laura/Kimberly: once you get ACME legal ack, I’ll open a small UI PR to add the tooltip and the screenshot to the docs.
- Aditya: can you help coordinate a quick legal sign-off call if ACME needs it?

Marcus
Product Manager, Console UX — Redwood Inference

Attachment: console-mockup-privacy-panel.png
